title: Assessment Mode — Automated Phase Chain for LAN and Web Assessments
goal: Allow an operator to select an assessment type (e.g. 'Full Internal LAN', 'Full External Web', 'Full AD Assessment'), approve once per phase tier, and have AegisPT automatically chain all relevant runners in the correct order without requiring per-task button presses.
scope: Implement an Assessment Mode concept with three built-in assessment chains: (1) FULL-INTERNAL-LAN: Phase 1 passive (auto) → nmap discovery, LDAP enum, EASM if domain provided. Phase 2 active (single approval) → nmap service scan, nuclei CVE scan, httpx fingerprint, BloodHound collection, NetExec passive SMB. Phase 3 intrusive-credential (single approval) → Responder poisoning, Kerberoast, AS-REP roast, hash cracking, NetExec authenticated, password spray if lockout policy allows. Phase 4 intrusive-exploitation (single approval) → Metasploit against confirmed findings, Impacket lateral movement, DCSync if DA credentials obtained. (2) FULL-EXTERNAL-WEB: Phase 1 passive (auto) → EASM subdomain discovery, httpx fingerprint. Phase 2 active (single approval) → nuclei full scan, ZAP/Burp active scan, biz-logic-probe. Phase 3 intrusive (single approval) → LLM probe if AI endpoints found, confirmation exploits via Metasploit allowlist. (3) FULL-AD-ASSESSMENT: BloodHound → Kerberoast → credential attacks → lateral movement chain. Implementation: an AssessmentChain model stores: assessment_type, current_phase, phase_approvals (per-phase approval state), auto_advance_on_phase_complete (bool), phases (list of phase definitions with runner lists). The operator approves each phase tier once — all tasks within that phase run automatically in dependency order. Moving to the next phase requires re-approval only if the phase has a higher intrusive tier than the current one. Phase transition happens automatically if auto_advance is enabled and the previous phase completed without errors. The Mission Control UI shows a phase progress bar with the current phase highlighted. An operator can halt at any phase boundary. This is the 'no button per task' experience the user described.
generation_reason: The user explicitly requested that when a test type is selected, the system should run everything automatically without requiring a button press for each step. Assessment Mode implements this: approve once per phase tier, the system handles the rest. This is how NodeZero and XBOW operate — the operator sets the scope and approves the level, the system executes the full chain. This is the single feature that transforms AegisPT from a manual orchestration tool into an autonomous assessment platform.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Phase approvals replace per-task approvals — not eliminate approval entirely. Each higher intrusive tier still requires explicit operator approval before phase starts. Kill switch halts the entire chain immediately. Scope enforcement is absolute across all phases. Phase 4 (exploitation) never auto-starts without explicit intrusive-exploitation approval even if auto_advance is enabled for lower tiers.

success_criteria: Three built-in assessment chains exist: FULL-INTERNAL-LAN, FULL-EXTERNAL-WEB, FULL-AD-ASSESSMENT.
Operator selects assessment type in intake, approves each phase tier once.
All tasks within an approved phase run automatically in dependency order.
Phase transition to a higher intrusive tier requires explicit approval.
Exploitation phase (Phase 4) NEVER auto-advances — always requires explicit approval.
Kill switch halts the entire chain immediately.
Mission Control shows phase progress bar with current phase and completed phases.
Operator can halt at any phase boundary.
AI agent (backlog-60) provides real-time analysis between phases to guide phase approval.
Tests cover chain execution, phase approval gates, auto-advance, exploitation-gate enforcement, kill-switch.
must_not_touch: Running phases without their required approval tier
pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: Three assessment chains available in intake.
Phase approval model works — one approval per tier.
Exploitation phase requires explicit approval even with auto_advance enabled.
Phase progress visible in Mission Control.

before_promotion: Impacket lateral movement runner (backlog-75) is completed and logged.

Update CURRENT_STATE.md with Assessment Mode as active orchestration capability.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
